spellbook.finance/limitations: A live run is irreversible from here. This tool cannot end or edit the listing it created, and a buyer can buy within seconds. Call it with dryRun true first, every time.
It answers 403 feature_disabled unless the workspace is on the allowlist for the ebay_custom_lots flag, and a delegated agent also needs agent marketplace writes switched on.

It does not reserve stock. The copies stay in the inventory, and a sale on another channel can leave the deck short before it sells. Free copies count unlocked near-mint nonfoil and foil copies of any printing under the card name.
A live run answers 409 and publishes nothing when any card has fewer free near-mint copies than the deck needs, or when deckFormat is set and a card is not legal there. The refusals name each card.
A scryfallId SpellBook Finance does not know answers 400 and names the id.
Photos are catalog images of one printing per card, up to 12 nonbasic cards. Basic lands count toward the deck and get no photo.
eBay's player-built decks category accepts only New or Used, so the listing goes out as Used (excellent) with a near-mint description.

ebay_selling_limit with status 409 means the seller's eBay account sits at its monthly selling limit, so eBay refuses new listings. Nothing was sent, and a dryRun still works. Do not retry the live run before eBay reports headroom or a new month starts.
It requires a connected eBay account with seller setup complete. Neither is something this tool can arrange, so a person does both in a browser.

description: Publish a player-built deck from one workspace as ONE live eBay listing in eBay's player-built decks category. You choose the cards, the title, the summary, the ask and the shipping charge. This tool never suggests a price, ranks cards or picks a deck for you. It reports, per card, how many free near-mint copies the workspace holds and, when deckFormat is set, whether Scryfall lists the card as legal in that format. ALWAYS call it once with dryRun true and show the person the preview, the per-card counts and the refusals before calling it again with dryRun false, because a live run creates a real listing a real buyer can buy. A live run returns the eBay listingId and listingUrl, or the refusals. It does not reserve the copies, and it does not know whether another channel sells them first.

archetype.description: An archetype label for the listing, such as Burn. Omit when the deck has none.

cards.description: The deck list, at most 100 rows and 500 cards in total. Rows that share a card name are merged. Required.

quantity.description: How many copies of this card the deck holds.

scryfallId.description: The Scryfall id of one printing, from spellbook_printings_search. Any printing of the card counts toward the same card name.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

deckFormat.description: A Scryfall legality format key such as pauper or commander. When set, a card that is not legal or restricted in it blocks a live run. Omit to skip the legality check.

dryRun.description: True previews the listing with no eBay call. False publishes for real. Defaults to true; a live run needs an explicit false.

priceUsd.description: The listing price in USD for the whole deck, from 0.99 to 2000. Required. The person decides it.

shippingUsd.description: The flat shipping charge in USD the buyer pays, from 0 to 50. Use 0 for free shipping. Required.

summary.description: A short description of the deck for the listing body, at most 1000 characters. Required.

title.description: The eBay listing title, at most 80 characters. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose copies make up the deck. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_lot_publish
